name: obsidian-task-scan
title: Scan Obsidian vault for tasks that could become puddle requests

specification.purpose: List the open task lines ("- [ ]") in an Obsidian vault, with the file each came from, as candidates for puddle requests.

inputs.name: folder
inputs.description: Subfolder of the vault to scan, relative to the vault root. Empty scans the whole vault.

specification.output: A list of open tasks, each with the task text, the vault-relative file path and the line number.

settings.name: vaultPath
settings.description: Absolute path to the Obsidian vault folder.
